content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy promise simplicity but deliver dependency. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery—until they don’t. Your store lives on their servers. Your payments route through their processors. Your customer data sits in their databases. When they block your country or flag your account, you lose everything overnight. Sovereign infrastructure flips this model. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack deploys your store on Cloudflare Pages (free), processes payments via NOWPayments (0.5% fee), and delivers files from Cloudflare R2 (pay-as-you-go storage). No middlemen. No platform risk. You own the code, the data, and the process. It’s not simpler—it’s structurally independent. Trade convenience for control. Choose which risk you’re willing to carry.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on OFAC sanctions, local regulation, or perceived fraud risk. Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and Venezuela are routinely blocked, not because creators are untrustworthy, but because compliance costs outweigh profit margins. Platforms like Gumroad inherit these restrictions. If Stripe won’t process your payments, neither will they. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. NOWPayments verifies crypto transactions on-chain—no KYC, no buyer accounts, no geographic restrictions. Payments settle directly to your wallet. The Edge Commerce Stack configures this automatically. It’s not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure that doesn’t care where you operate. Compliance becomes your responsibility, but so does your revenue. This is the tradeoff of sovereignty.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

PayPal holds funds for 21 days in restricted regions when it works at all. Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction in permitted countries. Crypto payment processors like NOWPayments charge 0.5% with no holding period. The Edge Commerce Stack integrates NOWPayments with Cloudflare Workers for instant webhook verification. Funds hit your wallet the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. Recommended networks (BSC, Solana, TRON) keep fees under $0.10 per transaction. Conventional platforms hide their true costs in currency conversion markups, rolling reserves, and sudden account freezes. Sovereign infrastructure exposes all fees upfront. You pay for storage, bandwidth, and processing—nothing more. Calculate the real cost of renting vs. owning your stack.
Sovereign infrastructure removes platform risk, not business risk. Own your stack, manage your responsibilities.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

On Gumroad or Paddle, your product files live on their servers. They control access. They can delete your account without warning. The Edge Commerce Stack stores files in Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive—both accessible via signed URLs generated by your backend logic. Orders are logged in Supabase (free tier), not a third-party dashboard. Delivery is automated: payment triggers a webhook, Cloudflare Worker validates the transaction, signed URL is emailed to the buyer. You own the entire process. No platform can revoke your access. No customer data leaves your control. This is the difference between renting a storefront and building your own warehouse. Maintenance is your responsibility, but so is your sovereignty.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you sell one product once a month and value zero maintenance, conventional platforms might suffice—until they don’t. If your business depends on consistent revenue, choose sovereign infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack is for creators who’ve been locked out of Stripe, had PayPal freeze their funds, or refuse to gamble on Gumroad’s next policy change. It’s not plug-and-play. It requires deployment, configuration, and occasional updates. But once live, it’s yours. No platform can shut you down. No country restriction applies. If you’re building a business, not a side hustle, own your infrastructure. Renting is always temporary. Sovereignty is permanent.

Conventional platforms offer convenience until they block your account or country. Sovereign stacks require more setup but deliver permanent control. Choose based on whether you prioritize ease or independence.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. 2. Provide your Cloudflare and NOWPayments API keys for deployment. 3. Receive your live store link within 48 hours. 4. Load up to 5 products with automated delivery. 5. Test end-to-end: purchase, payment, file delivery. 6. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email security. 7. Monitor transactions via Supabase dashboard. 8. Scale by adding more products or networks to NOWPayments.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Edge Commerce Stack if I’m not technical?

The stack is deployed for you, but basic maintenance requires understanding your infrastructure. COREMERCH provides 30-day support and full documentation. If you can follow instructions, you can manage it.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on decentralized networks. If their service fails, your funds are still secure on-chain. You can switch to another processor without losing access to your store or data.
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?
Crypto transactions are irreversible. Once payment confirms, the buyer receives the product. Fraud risk is lower because no buyer account is required. Verify transactions on-chain for added security.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for digital products. Physical goods require additional logistics not covered by this infrastructure. Focus on ebooks, courses, or software.
What if I need to scale beyond 5 products?
The stack is built on scalable infrastructure. Add more products by updating your Supabase database and Cloudflare R2 storage. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates for expansion.
Maintenance is the price of sovereignty. Deploy once, own forever. No subscriptions, no sudden shutdowns.
